title: 5e brainstorm: health metrics + similarity design
description:
Brainstorm the health and similarity layers using vidhi-brainstorm. Key areas:

- Health metrics per component and per file — complexity, coupling, cohesion, churn, instability (Martin's Ce/(Ca+Ce)), god-class scores. Which are computed from Layer 0 alone vs which need git history?
- **Git-organizational metrics as first-class health signals** — co_change_scatter, change_entropy (Hassan's HCM), ownership_risk (Bird et al.). Empirically calibrated as stronger defect predictors than structural complexity (repowise corpus AUC ~0.70). See survey doc for full ranking.
- **Hidden coupling** — files that co-change >=50% but have no static edge. Both an L1 fact and an L4 health signal.
- **Function-level blame rollup** — project blame onto L0 symbol line ranges for function-granular health (modification count, median age, owner).
- **Coverage gradient** — continuous signal (not binary threshold); absent != uncovered.
- **Category capping with proportional scaling** — prevent one category from dominating; keep per-finding attribution linear.
- **Calibration methodology** — T0 protocol (no future leakage), NLOC control column, leave-one-repo-out CV. Necessary to avoid weighting traps (developer_congestion leakage example).
- Time-series trends — snapshot model (already started in current code), health deltas in review reports, trend visualization
- Convention drift detection — tracking convention cohesion as time series. Alert when multi-agent development causes divergence. This bridges L4 and L2.
- Transitive health metrics via DD — blast radius aggregates, transitive coupling. What benefits from DD's incrementalization vs simple recomputation?
- HRR vectors for structural similarity (L6) — strip mode (structural shape) vs embed mode (semantic meaning). Validated in spike (4.4x lift structural, 57% transform). How to integrate into the core model.
- Semantic diff via HRR — not "what lines changed" but "what structural shape changed." Small text diff + large HRR delta = subtle behavioral change. Use in review reports.
- Near-duplicate detection — pattern families, refactoring candidates
- Incrementality — HRR vectors recompute per changed symbol (sub-ms). Health metrics update from deltas. What's real-time vs on-demand?
- Storage model — snapshots as ephemeral (recomputable) vs health baselines as durable?
- **What NOT to invest in** — classic structural code smells (brain_method, LCOM4, bumpy_road) are weak defect predictors. Keep as advisory/informational, don't let them drive scores.

Input: docs/sutra-vision.md (L4 + L6 sections), **docs/survey-repowise-health.md** (repowise comparison with calibrated weights, methodology, and specific biomarker designs), current snapshot/trend code, HRR spike results, 5a/5b/5c decisions
Output: shared understanding ready for PRD
decisions: Git-organizational data expands L0 — git facts stored alongside structural facts in the same ground truth layer
Finding-based health model — biomarkers emit findings with severity/provenance, scores derived via category-capping. Health never blocks; constraints are for blocking enforcement.

Three-tier biomarker set: Tier 1 advisory (co_change_scatter, change_entropy, ownership_risk, function_hotspot), Tier 2 advisory (nested_complexity, hidden_coupling, blast_radius×churn), Tier 3 informational (dead_code_ratio, code_age_volatility, coverage_gradient), plus sutra-specific (convention_drift, component_instability, hrr_shape_change). Classic structural smells excluded.
HRR strip + embed computed at parse time, 1024 f64s per function. Codebook durable. Bigram deferred to on-demand analysis.
L6 capabilities: structural similarity search, near-duplicate detection (snapshot-time with trending), semantic diff in review reports (text-Δ × HRR-Δ four-quadrant model).
Convention drift detected via both FCA (convention conformance over time) and HRR (structural clustering coherence).
Per-file health scores stored in snapshots for historical drill-down. Component scores aggregated from file scores.
Multi-agent ownership resolved via configurable alias mapping (owners.toml). Agent authors collapse to human dispatcher.
Adopt repowise calibrated weights as defaults. Sutra-specific biomarkers start informational, uncalibrated.
Dependency: sutra/67 widens 0024 migration to add commits(hash, committed_at, author) table for L4 git-organizational metrics.
